ruleDefinitions.name: Base64 MZ Header In CommandLine
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects encoded base64 MZ header in the commandline

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*TVqQAAMAAAAEAAAA.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*TVpQAAIAAAAEAA8A.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*TVqAAAEAAAAEABAA.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*TVoAAAAAAAAAAAAA.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*TVpTAQEAAAAEAAAA.*"))
